note: English translations of the heldout24 Chinese queries by DeepSeek deepseek-v4-flash through the same Dify workflow and prompt as demo20's queries_en_deepseek.json, on 2026-10-12, with max_tokens raised from 1024 to 4096 (NOTES 27). All 24 came back non-empty on the first run.

queries.h04: Why can't an asset that already has a work order be deleted?

queries.h06: During local development, where does fieldops read the database connection string from? If it is not configured, where does it connect by default?
queries.h07: What is old_status in the audit event written when the ticket was just created?
queries.h08: Can the reassignment reason be attached when reassigning a work order?
queries.h09: How is optimistic concurrency control (expected_version) implemented in fieldops?
queries.h10: What is the health check endpoint for fieldops? Does it connect to the database?
queries.h11: When fieldops runs database migrations, is the connection address written in alembic.ini?
queries.h12: Why don't fieldops integration tests leave data in the database?
queries.h13: Which MQTT topic does mineops subscribe to by default? Which port does it connect to?
queries.h14: What happens if observed_at has no timezone when reporting telemetry?

queries.h16: When querying historical telemetry for a non-existent device, what does the API return?
